description: Price history of one Polymarket or Kalshi market (bid / ask / mid / last) at 5m, 1h or 1d resolution over a from/to range, up to 2000 points per page (follow next_from). Get the market id from prediction_search_markets (free). Data is delayed by at least 24 hours (independently recorded from the public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs; not affiliated). Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

from.description: Start of the range: ISO-8601 date-time in UTC ('Z') or with an offset (2026-11-20T12:00:00Z, 2026-11-20T13:00:00+01:00), a plain date (2026-11-20 = midnight UTC) or Unix epoch seconds (1795132800). Points start at the first interval boundary after it, and never before the market was first recorded. Default: 'to' minus 1 day (interval=5m), 7 days (1h) or 90 days (1d). Must be before 'to'.

id.description: Market id: numeric Polymarket id (e.g. 559651) or Kalshi ticker (e.g. KXELONMARS-99); 'polymarket:<id>' / 'kalshi:<ticker>' also accepted

interval.description: Spacing of the points: 5m (5 minutes), 1h (1 hour) or 1d (1 day). Default: 1h. Each point is the last quote recorded at or before its time; at most 2000 points per page, then follow next_from.

platform.description: Platform: polymarket or kalshi (lower case). Optional, default: inferred from the id (numeric id = polymarket, otherwise kalshi); ignored when the id is prefixed with 'polymarket:' or 'kalshi:'.

to.description: End of the range (inclusive), same formats as 'from'. Default and maximum: the data cutoff (now minus 24 h); later values are clamped to it.

name: prediction_market_history
title: Prediction market price history
